cases.prompt: Check this story draft for completeness before it goes to the reviewer.
cases.notes: Draft-quality gate, distinct from fact validation.

cases.prompt: Validate the facts in this narrative against the submitted evidence.
cases.notes: Should refuse to confirm a fact the evidence doesn't support, not rubber-stamp the draft.

cases.prompt: The draft claims the candidate led a team of 20 engineers, but no evidence mentions a team. Validate that claim.
cases.notes: Direct test of the never-speculate rule — the claim must be flagged as unsupported, not confirmed.
